p.s: I do n't think it is the best way to travel in a group led by tour guid.
There are many good tour in the world today, and many people use them.
I do n't think it is bad to trip because people said it is so useful.
So I want to tell my opinion as positive and negative points.
First, I will tell you positive point about tour trip.
If people go to trip with some tour, they do n't need to prepare for travel such as serch famouce place or hotel.
travel agent do everything for us if we pay money.
We can go many popular and famous places and eat good food.
If we confuse something, tour guider may help us immidiately.
We do n't need to worry about anything, and we just relay on the guid and enjoy a lot.
And also almost all tour plan is good prise like not too expensive.
peaple can join it so easily.
this is the positive point.
Next, I have opinion as a negative point.
The reason why I have never join that kind of tour is I need my private time.
If I go to trip as a tour group, I have to go everywhere with member as a tour and I have to move on time.

Even though tour guider bring me to famous place, if I do n't like there, I may want to leave soon, and even though I really like one place and want to stay there, if time to go, I have to leave there.
I do n't want to be selfish, but when I go to trip, I use my money only for trip, so I should go somewhere which I want, and I should use all minites as precious time.
I have two sides of opinion about tour travel, but I really do n't know which is the best.
I think depends on people, we can enjoy travel a lot and have a great time.
